coverage: Selected rules affecting M1 and shared safety; not exhaustive proof of all runtime policies

rules.rule: crm_leads/projects company, when set, must resolve to a company with tenant; this is not actor membership authorization
rules.target_registry_action: Keep structural DB constraint; register authority, legacy null policy and route-level membership guard separately

rules.rule: Tenant context enforces company list for ordinary tenant actors but permits legacy missing-tenant/platform/system bypass
rules.company_scope: request actor tenant; legacy exceptions present
rules.target_registry_action: Explicit privileged exception registry; M1 workload missing tenant/company denied

rules.rule: Write tools require crm_write scope; act-as user selected from header/default and checked active/company, binding delegation still requires review
rules.company_scope: API key allowed companies and tenant company list
rules.target_registry_action: Pin actor delegation and tool scope server-side; no self-selected privileged act-as identity

rules.rule: Intake attribution immutable; assigned_at updated only on assignee change; attribution projection follows Lead insert
rules.company_scope: CRM lead company and allowlisted source metadata
rules.target_registry_action: Reference immutable source rule and keep assignment time distinct from human first response

rules.rule: Qualified requires usable contact, need in scope, area in service and evidence; expected revision and request replay guard mutations
rules.target_registry_action: Keep existing canonical qualification event writer; rule version identifies predicate/evidence requirements

rules.rule: Website feedback uses original receipt, measurement consent, qualification revision and exact destination/source checks before effect
rules.target_registry_action: Preserve purpose-specific guard; extend consent registry without treating historic receipt as current all-purpose grant

rules.rule: Native page/form/lead ID, active company recipient, pipeline/source and binding revision must match before atomic intake
rules.target_registry_action: Keep source identity validation; normalize integration event envelope without enabling second writer

rules.rule: Current guard rejects invalid signature only when header is present; ACK precedes durable handler work
rules.target_registry_action: Do not preserve weak behavior as allowed policy; design fail-closed signature/binding and durable inbox before ACK

rules.rule: Required open tasks/evidence can block forward stage advance; terminal/backward transitions have explicit skip policy
rules.company_scope: CRM Lead/Deal pipeline and task source
rules.target_registry_action: Register conditions/exceptions with native stage version; no automatic copying as global permission override

rules.rule: Completion may require files/customer notes/contact or typed evidence; SX-specific skip path exists
rules.company_scope: task/template/executor domain, not table name alone
rules.target_registry_action: Keep evidence policy and explicit SX exception; normalize COMPLETED acceptance without blanket bypass

rules.rule: One deadline derivation helper selects CRM/production/logistics deadlines and completed-stage behavior; company clocks provide overrides
rules.target_registry_action: Reference existing function/tests; version SLA/calendar source rather than adding another derived deadline column

rules.rule: Deal payment amount positive; stages/paid totals derived; invoice mirror links original deal payment
rules.target_registry_action: Canonical transaction/alias map; never count mirror twice or infer real cash from stage

rules.rule: Project stage transitions query approval_rules/project_approvals and approver routing
rules.target_registry_action: Reuse routing/history after explicit mapping; canonical Decision must add exact payload/rule/fact/scope/TTL and separation

rules.rule: Graph only skips FAIL; UNKNOWN remains traversable; wait/approve are pass-through kinds
rules.target_registry_action: Do not use graph traversal as effect authorization; four-gate DENY/UNKNOWN evaluated independently before dispatch

rules.rule: No Redis or Redis error permits local execution as legacy single-instance fallback
rules.target_registry_action: Keep scheduling owner; require DB lease/fence/effect identity for M1 side effects before scale

rules.rule: Draft generation checks summed daily usage before provider call, anonymizes context and validates output; no atomic global reservation is evident
rules.target_registry_action: Reuse anonymize/output checks; route each model/reviewer/retry through canonical reservation and taint controls

rules.rule: Prompt requests tool-derived reports; runtime tool_choice auto can return text without tools and caps loop at four iterations
rules.company_scope: user/session context with remembered company hints
rules.target_registry_action: Treat prompt as advisory data; enforce report computation/tool contract outside model; separate reviewer PASS/FAIL max_rounds

rules.rule: Facts replace/load by user_id and unique user/source/fact; company_id inside session JSON is not enforced storage partition
rules.company_scope: current persistent key is user-based; company partition not proven
rules.target_registry_action: Add enforced tenant/company session namespace and taint provenance; cannot carry memory across company switch

rules.rule: Code defaults prune Facebook webhook logs after 14 days, user activity after 180 days; notifications default 60 days
rules.company_scope: runtime jobs with environment overrides; actual configured policy UNKNOWN
rules.target_registry_action: Register retention classes/override sources and legal owner; these defaults do not establish audit receipt retention

rules.rule: General audit insert is fail-safe and does not throw; MCP logs allow/deny/error with reason and trace
rules.target_registry_action: Critical command/audit receipt transaction must be durable; generic telemetry failure is not command evidence
